message: Added Sitagliptin 50 mg once daily. Continue Metformin. Bring glucose logs and repeat HbA1c before next visit.
If dizziness or unusual fatigue is logged, note timing and discuss during follow-up. Do not change medicines without review.
Please bring latest lab report and pharmacy refill receipts to the diabetes follow-up.
Track home BP readings for two weeks before review.
Bring discharge papers and current medicine strips for reconciliation.
